_about: Snapshot for lib/beta-zip-proximity.test.ts, taken 2026-10-20. claims = location_zips joined to locations (loc_other excluded), 1,535 rows. coords = US Census 2025 ZCTA Gazetteer internal points + states from the 2020 zip-to-county file, for every claimed zip the Census carries and the test zips. Public reference data; no customer data.
